title: Transitions
summary: Soft, fast cuts: a short zoom-blur push, a blur dissolve, a white dip (into a light shot) and a punch-in. Keep them 0.2-0.4 s.

items.name: blur dissolve
items.description: The shot goes soft as the next comes up out of the same blur.

items.name: soft zoom
items.description: A short soft zoom-blur push into the next shot.

items.name: white dip
items.description: A quick dip through white: for the switch into a light shot.

items.name: punch zoom
items.description: A fast punch-in onto the next shot, for a hard beat.
